description: The rules this system must keep. Each rule has a stable id, the entities and fields it touches, what the code does today, the defect rows that show the gap, and the stage that will enforce it. enforced_today is false on every rule. The repo has no code that enforces any of them.

rules.name: a missing id must not return another device
rules.statement: When no device row has the requested id, the lookup returns no device. It does not return the first row or any other row.
rules.current_behaviour: domain_service.load_record returns rows[0] when no cell matches. GET /records/DOES-NOT-EXIST returns the REC-0001 row with HTTP 200. The summary of a missing id is a summary of REC-0001.
rules.stage_note: Operating contract row 2 allows GET /records/{id} to return 404 for a missing id. The inherited test test_missing_id_returns_first_row will fail at that point and must be replaced.

rules.name: a record lookup matches the key column only
rules.statement: The lookup compares the requested id with device_id only. It does not compare the id with hostname, vendor, or any other cell.
rules.current_behaviour: load_record tests record_id in row.values(). A request for the word legacy would return a row whose hostname is legacy.

rules.name: AI output cannot execute
rules.statement: Text from a model is a recommendation. No code path takes that text and changes a device, a circuit, an order, or an incident. The model never holds the execute agency.
rules.current_behaviour: The live gateway returns the sentence Review and approve before action. No execute route exists. The risk is a later worker who treats the JSON as a change ticket.

rules.name: alarm last_seen_at cannot precede first_seen_at
rules.statement: On every alarm row, last_seen_at is the same time as first_seen_at or later. A row that breaks this is flagged and does not become an incident on its own.
rules.current_behaviour: 166 of 354 alarm rows have last_seen_at before first_seen_at. Example ALA-00002 on file line 3. No code reads the file.
rules.stage_note: Project_Intent.md 2.7 says a row shaped like ALA-00002 is flagged and does not become an incident. The flag compares two timestamps. It needs no cutoff.

rules.name: a shared admin account is not least privilege
rules.statement: Each actor uses its own identity with only the actions it needs. A shared user whose password sits in source, and an admin role that is allowed every action, both break this. Neither counts as least privilege.
rules.current_behaviour: legacy/reconcile_legacy.py holds user app_shared and a password in the source file. The same password text is in .env.example. policy/opa/access.rego allows any admin for any action. The gap list names overpowered_automation_account. Whether automation_service is the app_shared account is Unknown.
rules.stage_note: Stage S04-04 moves the password to the environment. Stage S04-03 and S04-06 replace admin-any with per-persona rules. No password value appears in this file.

rules.name: duplicate dedupe_key within a storm_batch_id is one alarm
rules.statement: Two alarm rows with the same dedupe_key and the same storm_batch_id are one alarm shown twice. They count as one alarm. The rows stay on disk. Grouping does not delete a row.
rules.current_behaviour: Three dedupe_key values appear twice. No code groups them. The check is string equality on two columns.
rules.stage_note: The pick in ai-qualification.md is deterministic code. How many alarms make a storm is Unknown. This rule sets no count.

rules.name: an AI recommendation needs a policy result, an approval id, and an audit row before any state change
rules.statement: Before any change follows a model recommendation, three things exist in this order. The access policy returned allow. A named human wrote an approval id. An audit row was written. Then, and only then, a change may run. The change must also be reversible and validated.
rules.current_behaviour: The summary route calls no policy. No route writes an approval id. The audit row for ai.summary holds record_id and model only. All three gates are absent.
rules.stage_note: Operating contract rows 2 and 9 and Project_Intent.md Appendix C name the four gates. The approver desk job is network_engineer, confirmed by Mangesh (FDE) on 2026-10-10. Stage S04-09 uses this title.

rules.name: mgmt_ip, credential_profile, and credentials never enter a prompt
rules.statement: The prompt text sent to a model never contains mgmt_ip, credential_profile, a password, a key, or a token. The allow list in ai-context-policy.yaml names the fields that may enter.
rules.current_behaviour: PROMPT_TEMPLATE.format(record=record) places the whole device row in the prompt, including both fields.

rules.name: a stale topology flag blocks a recommendation
rules.statement: When stale_topology_flag is true, the recommendation call stops before the model runs. The outcome is BLOCK. What a blank flag should do is Unknown.
rules.current_behaviour: The flag is inside the returned row. No branch reads it. 192 rows are true.

rules.name: a denied access writes an audit row and a deny status
rules.statement: When a role is refused, the response status says refused and an audit row records the refusal. A refused call is not invisible.
rules.current_behaviour: A role outside the five-name list gets HTTP 200 with body error forbidden and no audit line.

rules.name: a call without a role is not treated as operator
rules.statement: A call that sends no role header is refused. The server does not fill in operator for the caller.
rules.current_behaviour: Header(default="operator") on the record route allows the read. The summary route checks no role at all.

rules.name: an audit row names the actor and the request chain
rules.statement: Every audit row holds who acted, which request chain it belongs to, and, for a model call, which approval id and policy result applied. See metric.audit_completeness.
rules.current_behaviour: audit.write_event writes ts, action, and details. No actor, no correlation id, no approval id.

rules.name: one row per business key
rules.statement: Each key value appears on one row of its table. A second row with the same key is a defect to hold aside, not a second object.
rules.current_behaviour: Each of the six CSV files has three keys that appear twice. Whether the repeated id should collapse is Unknown. Writes under data/synthetic are prohibited.
